mentions.name: Osaurus
mentions.description: Osaurus is a native macOS harness for AI agents that runs a full agent loop locally to get work done on-device. It is open-source, Swift-based, and includes a custom-built inference engine written natively rather than in Python.
mentions.problem: Every other inference engine is based on Python; Osaurus provides a native, Swift-based alternative.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I've been building native macOS harness called Osaurus https://osaurus.ai/

It's full featured with agent loop, gets work done locally.

It's open-source and Swift-based, we built our own inferencing engine since every other engine is based on Python. Check us out - https://github.com/osaurus-ai/osaurus
